paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Mosi leh Samuel ka ma ah hong dingh mah le uh, ka lungsim hiai mite lam anga tuan kei ding. Ka muh phak louh ah delhkhia inla, paimang uhen!
heading: Judah Mipite Tunggikna
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not turn toward this people. Cast them out of my sight, and let them go out!

paite: Huan koi ah ka pai ding ua chi a nang a hon dot uleh hichi in akiang uah na chi ding hi. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Sihna a si dingte, sihna ah; namsau thuak dingte, namsau ah; kial thuak dingte, kial ah; saltang dingte, saltanna ah.
english: It will happen when they ask you, ‘Where shall we go out?’ then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh says: “Such as are for death, to death; such as are for the sword, to the sword; such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.”’

paite: Thil li ka sehsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; that ding in namsau, keizan ding in ui, ne khin leh hihmang ding in tung leng vasate leh gam sahangte.
english: “I will appoint over them four kinds,” says Yahweh: “the sword to kill, the dogs to tear, the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah tapa Manasseh in Jerusalem a athilhih ziak in lei kumpipa gam tengteng lak a vial sepsep ding in ka bawl ding.
english: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

paite: "Kua'n ahon hehpih dia aw Jerusalem? Kua'n hon lungkhampih dia? Na omdan dong ding in kua alampial dia oi?
english: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? Who will mourn you? Who will come to ask of your welfare?

paite: Nang na hon paikhia a, na nungtawn tawn a," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. "Huchi in kisik ka chimtak a, na tung ah ka khut ka lika, ka hon hihmang hi.
english: You have rejected me,” says Yahweh. “You have gone backward. Therefore I have stretched out my hand against you and destroyed you. I am weary of showing compassion.

paite: Gam pumpi a kulh kongpite ah kizapna in amau ka zap a, ta bei in ka bawl a, ka mite ka hihmang a; a-omdan uh akiheisan louh ziak un.
english: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land. I have bereaved them of children. I have destroyed my people. They didn’t return from their ways.

paite: Tuipi piaunel sang a tam in ameithaite uh ka pungsak ding a, suntang lai in tangvalte siatna ding in atung uah lokmi ka tungsak a, mangbatna leh thil mulkimhuai ka tungsak guih hi.
english: Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas. I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday. I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

paite: Sagih suangnu abahgawp a; akha akhahta; sun ahih lai in ani aketa, zahlak in alungbuai a; huan akhosuaksunte, amelmate uh khut ah namsau a thah ding in ka pe ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: She who has borne seven languishes. She has given up the spirit. Her sun has gone down while it was yet day. She has been disappointed and confounded. I will deliver their residue to the sword before their enemies,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Nu ei, gam pumpi a kituahlouhna mi leh kikalhna mi a na hon na suan ka tung gik hi na tel e! Ka leitawisak kei a, mite'n leng ahon leitawisak kei uh; himahleh avek un hamsia ahon loh uhi.
heading: TOUPA Kiang A Jeremiah Thutut
english: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet every one of them curses me.

paite: TOUPA'N, chihtak ngial in thil hoih a ding in ka hon hihkip ding; chihtak ngial in siatna ni leh haksatna ni in melma na kiang ah khut ka dohsak ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “Most certainly I will strengthen you for good. Most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

paite: Sik in mallam sik leh ngen akitansak thei dia hia?
english: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and bronze?

paite: "Gam pumpi a na khelhna tengteng ziak in na hauhsakna leh na goute, aman bei in gallak ding in ka pe ding.
english: I will give your substance and your treasures for a plunder without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

paite: Na theih ngei louh gam ah na melmate nna ka hon semsak ding. Ka heh ziak a na tung a mei ampha ding akuangkheta hi," achi hi.
english: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which will burn on you.”

paite: Nang na thei hi, aw TOUPA, hon theigige inla, hong veh in, hon simmohte tung ah phuba hon laksak in. Na dohzohna ke'n manthat loh kei leng; nang ziak a minsiat thuak ka hi chih thei in.
english: Yahweh, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.

paite: Na thute hihlat ahia, ka ne a, na thute kei a ding in kipahna leh ka lungtang nopna ahi; aw TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, na min lah ka puta ngal ua.
english: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.

paite: Nopbawl mite lak ah ka tel kei a, ka kipahpih sam kei; nang khut ziak in ka tu tuam a, lungkimlouhna in na hon dimsak hi.
english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled me with indignation.

paite: Bangziak a ka natna dai thei lou a, ka liamna damthei lou ahia, hihdam ut lou bang mai a? Ka tung ah phaizang khemhat tui kang sekte bang na hi ding a hia?
english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, like waters that fail?

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kiheileh angei ka hon bangsak ding, ka ma ah na dingh nawn ding. Thil gina lou a kipan thil manpha ngen na genkhiakleh keimah kam bang na hi ding. Amau nang lam hong nga uhenla, nang bel amau lam na nga ding ahi kei.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, “If you return, then I will bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take out the precious from the vile, you will be as my mouth. They will return to you, but you will not return to them.

paite: Hiai mite lak ah ngen kulhbaang in ka hon bawl ding a, ahon sual ding ua, himahleh ahon zou kei ding uh, nang hon hondam ding leh hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall. They will fight against you, but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Migiloute khut a kipan ka hon hunkhe ding a, mi lauhuaite khut a kipan ka hon pawtkhesak ding.
english: “I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.”
